verdict.rationale: The docs say traces can be filtered, exported, shared and compared "via the UI or API", and LangSmith ships Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs plus an official MCP server, so programmatic access covers core workflows. Nothing in the evidence states full API parity with the UI, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at the standard docs paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage for dashboards, alerts, annotation queues, rules and automations, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
